text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'm so glad! Just pure 
happiness! That's how I feel.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: ...I have not said anything yet, though?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
"...It was your birthday, wasn't it? Happy 
birthday."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Goodness. Because I thanked you at 
lightning speed, I ended up having to say 
it twice. Still, it brings me joy, so no 
matter. Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, congratulations. My, delightful as 
ever, I see. However... speaking of light 
before me, are you?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Very well. Then I, Agnes Tachyon, shall 
grant you the ultimate—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood, let's go. I am fully prepared. 
Dancing, celebrations, yay for presents! 
Naturally. I will finish all the food as 
well. Thanks for the feast.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
No, hear me out first. What I am talking 
about is an experiment...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Seeing it with my own eyes, indeed. I 
understand. Food is meant to be savored 
with the eyes as well. I must go before 
the steam dissipates.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Well, the others are actually the ones 
preparing the party; we just came to call 
for you, but...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
It's quite rare to see someone let your 
words slide by so easily. ...It is 
amusing, I must admit.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that a bit harsh? If that's how it's 
gonna be, I'll make you listen to me no 
matter what, and then—
